method: Read source passages from16 actual primary interview publications and every card. Checked named collaborators, technical platform scopes, dates, attribution and all5 complete proposed parent bodies. Cross-publication budget groups include title/summary/headings. Six public sentences copyedited for direct prose; original author snapshot preserved in research.
